# Day Cluster Health

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

The health-related data and notes within a Day Cluster, capturing tracked health events for that day.

## Scope note

Populated via automated health sync (glucose, insulin, blood pressure, EKG); see HealthEvent and its narrower types for the individual data points aggregated here.
